title: Scene · Ten-cell corridor
brief: A straight corridor of ten 280 mm cells: 268 mm clear, 36 mm a side for the class robot. Each run scores 100 if the robot never touches a wall and 0 if it does; the score is the mean of the runs.

score.summary: round(sum(r in runs: r.points) / count(r in runs: true), 1)
